description: Unit test class for ImmutableFeatureProperties, testing equality, immutability, JSON serialization, and validation of property keys.

classes.name: ImmutableFeaturePropertiesTest
classes.description: JUnit test class verifying the behavior of ImmutableFeatureProperties, including equality, immutability, JSON output, and key validation.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Tests that ImmutableFeatureProperties satisfies the contract for equals and hashCode using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that ImmutableFeatureProperties instances are immutable.

methods.name: createInstanceReturnsTheExpectedJson
methods.description: Checks that an empty ImmutableFeatureProperties instance serializes to '{}' as JSON.

methods.name: ensureFeaturesToBuilderWorks
methods.description: Tests that calling toBuilder() on a predefined Feature object returns an equivalent object.

methods.name: createInvalidPropertyKey
methods.description: Ensures that setting a property with an invalid key (containing '/') throws JsonKeyInvalidException.

methods.name: createInvalidNestedPropertyKey
methods.description: Ensures that setting a nested property with an invalid key throws JsonKeyInvalidException.

methods.name: createInvalidNestedNestedPropertyKey
methods.description: Ensures that setting a nested nested property with an invalid key throws JsonKeyInvalidException.

methods.name: createTooLargePropertyKey
methods.description: Checks that a property key exceeding maximum length throws JsonKeyInvalidException.
